as_told.title: Air Force refers Noah Hradek's PPD FOIA request to the NSA

plain: An independent researcher named Noah Hradek used the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask the Air Force about Project Preserve Destiny. That is the program a former sergeant named Dan Sherman says recruited him to communicate with aliens. Michels tells this across several episodes. He says the Air Force passed the request on to the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, and he reads from the Air Force's reply: "Good afternoon. This letter is in final response to your 27th of July, 2023 Freedom of Information Act request." To Michels, the handoff to the NSA suggests the program is real.
